title: Polal SMP
description: POLAL SMP - A competitive survival SMP focused on PvP, building, raiding, economy, and player freedom. Build bases and alliances, fight wars and traps, and enjoy a balanced economy with minimal admin interference.
body:
⚔️ POLAL SMP ⚔️
A competitive survival SMP focused on PvP, building, raiding, economy, and player freedom.

🏠 Build bases, towns, and alliances
⚔️ PvP, wars, traps, and strategy
💰 Balanced economy with minimal admin interference
🌍 Expanding world border & active community
🚫 No pay-to-win, no abusive rules, no unfair advantages

Play your way — become rich, dominate in PvP, build empires, or survive quietly.
